detailed_descriptions.en: Dig Through Junk Break down piles of trash, scrap, broken machines, car parts, and forgotten junk. Every pile can hide something useful, valuable, or just weird. Restore Your Dream Car Earn money, buy missing parts, and rebuild a rusty old car piece by piece until your dream is ready to ride again. Complete Customer Orders Strange customers will arrive with strange requests. Find rare parts, prepare their cars, and get paid for your work. Rescue Dogs Find lost dogs hiding in the junkyard, rescue them, give them a home, and let them help you while you work. Upgrade Everything Upgrade your tools, improve your workflow, drive a forklift, and use the magnetic crane to clear bigger piles of junk faster. Find Collectibles Search for lost collectible cards and other rare treasures hidden deep in the trash. Relax Take breaks, enjoy the music, chill with your dogs, and embrace the cozy junkyard atmosphere.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Dig Through Junk

Break down piles of trash, scrap, broken machines, car parts, and forgotten junk. Every pile can hide something useful, valuable, or just weird.

Restore Your Dream Car

Earn money, buy missing parts, and rebuild a rusty old car piece by piece until your dream is ready to ride again.

Complete Customer Orders

Strange customers will arrive with strange requests. Find rare parts, prepare their cars, and get paid for your work.

Rescue Dogs

Find lost dogs hiding in the junkyard, rescue them, give them a home, and let them help you while you work.

Upgrade Everything

Upgrade your tools, improve your workflow, drive a forklift, and use the magnetic crane to clear bigger piles of junk faster.

Find Collectibles

Search for lost collectible cards and other rare treasures hidden deep in the trash.

Relax

Take breaks, enjoy the music, chill with your dogs, and embrace the cozy junkyard atmosphere.
